entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Horror-flavored plane inspired by 1790s European horror tales, born of the graveyard flavor.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: Planeswalker discussed as a character with future story work to do; his card in the graveyard is treated as a memory, not a body.

entities.name: Ezuri, Renegade Leader
entities.description: Legendary elf used with Garruk as an example of unique persons whose cards sit in graveyards.

entities.name: Avacynian Priest
entities.description: Example of a priest who gave her life in battle and may be raised by Disentomb.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: Guild led by a council of ghosts, whose keyword is haunt.

events.summary: The author argues that Garruk in the graveyard is a memory, not a body, because the official story has planeswalkers leave for another plane when out of loyalty.
events.quote: the official story is more about planeswalkers zooming off to some other plane as soon as they run out of loyalty
